title: AI Fundamentals for Beginners
shortDescription: A structured, jargon-free introduction to modern Artificial Intelligence, large language models, prompt engineering, and everyday digital productivity.
fullDescription: Designed specifically for learners with zero computer science background. Understand how modern AI models think, formulate effective prompts, avoid common pitfalls like hallucinations, and integrate accessible AI tools into your daily academic or business workflow.
keyOutcomes: Grasp foundational concepts of LLMs, neural networks, and generative AI
Master prompt crafting frameworks for consistent, accurate outputs
Select the right AI tool for text synthesis, research, and analysis
Apply responsible AI ethics, data privacy, and verification routines

syllabus.title: Core Concepts & Modern AI Landscape
syllabus.summary: How generative models work, understanding tokens, context windows, and model types.

syllabus.title: Systematic Prompt Engineering
syllabus.summary: Role-based prompts, few-shot examples, multi-turn reasoning, and output structuring.

syllabus.title: Essential AI Tool Suite
syllabus.summary: Hands-on practice with leading text, vision, and productivity tools.

syllabus.title: Responsible AI & Quality Verification
syllabus.summary: Detecting hallucinations, ethical guidelines, data safety, and fact-checking protocols.

title: Claude AI and AI Productivity
shortDescription: Harness Claude’s deep reasoning, long context window, and writing nuances to accelerate research, document analysis, and executive workflow speed.
fullDescription: Explore the architectural strengths of Anthropic Claude. Learn to analyze long reports (200k+ tokens), extract structured JSON/tables from messy documents, draft executive communications, and structure complex multi-step reasoning tasks.
keyOutcomes: Leverage massive context windows for comprehensive file and document synthesis
Master Claude Projects, custom project instructions, and knowledge bases
Extract structured data (tables, CSV, JSON) from complex PDFs and transcripts
Design reliable multi-step research and briefing workflows

syllabus.title: Claude Architecture & Context Mastery
syllabus.summary: Understanding context retention, Artifacts, and conversational memory.

syllabus.title: Knowledge Bases & Claude Projects
syllabus.summary: Organizing domain documents, defining project instructions, and workflow templates.

syllabus.title: Advanced Analytical & Writing Workflows
syllabus.summary: Executive briefs, research papers, contract summaries, and competitive audits.

syllabus.title: Prompt Optimization & XML Tagging
syllabus.summary: Using XML tags, thinking tags, and structured guidelines for deterministic reasoning.

title: Claude Code and AI-Assisted Development
shortDescription: Learn how to leverage Claude Code, terminal-based AI tools, and smart code generation to build web applications, scripts, and software prototypes.
fullDescription: Bridge the gap between ideas and functional software. Learn how terminal-driven AI tools like Claude Code inspect repositories, edit multi-file codebases, execute unit tests, and help junior developers or career switchers ship production-grade code with confidence.
keyOutcomes: Install and operate terminal-based AI development assistants safely
Understand project architectures, repo navigation, and automated git commits
Debug runtime errors, lint failures, and refactor legacy code using AI pair-programming
Build and deploy responsive modern web interfaces from scratch

syllabus.title: Terminal Fundamentals & AI CLI Setup
syllabus.summary: Setting up the environment, CLI essentials, safety boundaries, and workspace permissions.

syllabus.title: Repo Navigation & Multi-File Architecture
syllabus.summary: Instructing AI agents to read file trees, plan changes, and execute precise refactors.

syllabus.title: Building Interactive Web Applications
syllabus.summary: Creating TypeScript, React, and API integrations with real-time feedback loops.

syllabus.title: Testing, Debugging, and Safe Version Control
syllabus.summary: Writing tests, interpreting stack traces, creating git pull requests, and automated deployment.

title: AI Agents and Intelligent Assistants
shortDescription: Move beyond simple chatbots to autonomous AI agents capable of planning, using tools, searching the web, executing tasks, and handling memory.
fullDescription: Dive into the next frontier of artificial intelligence. Master agentic loops, task decomposition, external tool invocation, memory architectures, and human-in-the-loop oversight to create reliable digital assistants that perform real work.
keyOutcomes: Understand ReAct (Reason + Act) patterns and autonomous execution loops
Equip AI agents with custom tools, web search, calculators, and API callers
Implement structured memory systems and context management strategies
Design safety guardrails, human validation checkpoints, and failure recovery

syllabus.title: The Agentic Paradigm & Anatomy
syllabus.summary: Sensors, reasoning engines, memory stores, and action actuators.

syllabus.title: Tool Calling & API Integrations
syllabus.summary: Function calling schemas, handling API payloads, and response parsing.

syllabus.title: Multi-Step Planning & Self-Correction
syllabus.summary: Reflective loops, error recovery strategies, and verification steps.

syllabus.title: Human-in-the-Loop & Safety Boundaries
syllabus.summary: Confidence thresholds, confirmation modals, and boundary constraints.

title: AI Automation and Business Workflows
shortDescription: Connect AI intelligence with business apps like email, spreadsheets, CRMs, and messaging channels to streamline client operations and save hundreds of hours.
fullDescription: A practical programme focused on commercial business impact. Discover how small businesses, agencies, and freelancers can automate customer inquiry triage, lead nurturing, document parsing, invoice processing, and content workflows using AI integrations.
keyOutcomes: Map repetitive business processes and identify high-ROI AI automation targets
Connect LLMs with webhooks, spreadsheets, email triggers, and CRM databases
Build automated client onboarding, quote generators, and support triage systems
Package and sell automation solutions as an independent freelancer or agency

syllabus.title: Workflow Auditing & Opportunity Assessment
syllabus.summary: Identifying time sinks, quantifying automation ROI, and business readiness.

syllabus.title: No-Code & Low-Code AI Connectors
syllabus.summary: Connecting webhook triggers, email parsing, Google Sheets, and Slack alerts.

syllabus.title: Document Processing & Data Extraction
syllabus.summary: Extracting structured data from PDF receipts, supplier invoices, and contracts.

syllabus.title: Commercial Freelancing & Client Delivery
syllabus.summary: Scoping automation projects, writing proposals, pricing services, and maintenance contracts.

title: Building and Deploying AI Solutions
shortDescription: End-to-end engineering: from prototyping an AI application on your laptop to hosting, domain configuration, production security, and client handoff.
fullDescription: Take your AI products to the world. Learn full-stack fundamentals, environment variables security, serverless hosting (Vercel, Cloud Run), client rate-limiting, user feedback instrumentation, and ongoing model monitoring.
keyOutcomes: Build full-stack AI web applications with robust frontend and backend architectures
Secure API keys, handle CORS, and implement server-side proxy layers safely
Deploy applications to modern cloud hosting platforms with continuous delivery
Monitor token usage, latency, and system reliability in production environments

syllabus.title: Full-Stack Architecture for AI Apps
syllabus.summary: Decoupling UI from backend logic, streaming responses, and optimistic updates.

syllabus.title: Security & Secret Management
syllabus.summary: Protecting keys, rate limiting, token budgets, and preventing prompt injection.

syllabus.title: Cloud Deployment & Custom Domains
syllabus.summary: Deploying containers, setting up SSL certificates, DNS routing, and CI/CD.

syllabus.title: Monitoring, Telemetry & Iteration
syllabus.summary: Tracking cost per user, latency monitoring, error handling, and gathering user feedback.
